metadata.name: Basic Link Creation
metadata.description: Demonstrates the creation of a basic link between two points
metadata.author: LinksPlatform Team

input.description: Create a link from point A (value: 1) to point B (value: 2)

expectedOutput.description: A new link with ID 3 connecting source 1 to target 2

rules: A link must have a source and a target
The system assigns a unique ID to each new link
Source and target can be any valid link ID or point ID
notes: This is the most basic operation in the Links system. The actual link ID may vary depending on the state of the system.
